annotations.text: Main: the live SfN 2026 page — flat buttons, solid cards, no glass/glow treatment.

GlassVariant: same content, copy and bt- design system as Main, exploring a glassmorphism direction. Glass (frosted, translucent) buttons throughout; a full-bleed glass overlay across the hero, frosted on the left behind the copy and clearing to the right so the (now black-faded, not white-faded) photo reads on its own; and purposeful glows only — a green glow on the Biotium Choice badge (validated/optimized), a blue hover-glow on card icons (signals interactivity), a pulsing glow on the video play button (signals playable media), a glow at the scroll-progress bar's leading edge (current position), and a small red text-glow on “WIN SWAG” (urgency). No purely decorative glow was added.
